verdict.rationale: Khoj is itself an AI assistant. Its docs show several ways to hand it tasks: chatting grounded in your files, scheduled automations that research and email results, custom agents with persona and tools, Python code execution for analysis, plots and reports, and autonomous online research. Community posts confirm chat exists but mostly discuss its early dependence on OpenAI rather than hands-on use of delegated tasks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of automations, agents or code execution working in practice; documentation of multi-step autonomous task execution beyond single queries.
